verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five drawbacks of bad conduct.
After examination, sensible people criticize you.
You feel lost when you die.

verses.pali: kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: And when your body breaks up, after death, you’re reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā duccarite.
verses.english: These are the five drawbacks of bad conduct.
There are these five benefits of good conduct.
After examination, sensible people praise you.
You don’t feel lost when you die.

verses.pali: kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: When your body breaks up, after death, you’re reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṁsā sucarite”ti.
verses.english: These are the five benefits of good conduct.”
